assessments.reasoning: Authenticity — publisher_live is Creative Commons' own /publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt. Integrity — the reported [5884,6024) digest matches the citation, and the whole-body digest matches the scoped revision and publisher_pin. Relevance — [5884,6024) contains §4(a)'s operative sentence. Interpretation — “waived, abandoned, surrendered, licensed or otherwise affected” expressly addresses the §2 waiver and §3 fallback separately. Applicability — the Statement of Purpose identifies the person applying CC0, and §4(a) specifies rights “held by Affirmer.” Contradiction — §§2–3 limit their operation to the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights, §1(iv) defers to §4(a), and §4(c) treats rights of other persons as a separate clearance question.

limitations: This describes the instrument's effect on rights held by the Affirmer. Separate grants, defenses, ownership questions and third-party clearances require their own evidence.
reasoning: When the Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work, §4(a) expressly preserves trademark and patent rights “held by Affirmer.” Its verbs cover both surrender under the waiver and licensing under the fallback. Its final phrase, “otherwise affected by this document,” also addresses other claimed effects of CC0 itself.
